resources.string: Downloads don\'t work in the built-in browser - please open the web UI in the browser.
A small draft model proposes tokens, the large model only verifies them. Costs RAM; on the MagicPad 3 Pro so far at best equally fast. Must match the model.
More = more gain when they are right, more loss when not. llama.cpp default: 3
Drafter on the CPU instead of the GPU (-ngld 0)
Applies a small change on top of the model at startup (e.g. uncensored). Must match the base model, otherwise startup fails.
1.00 = single, higher = stronger. AtomicChat recommends 1.75 for its uncensored LoRA.
1K to 64K in steps of 1024. The memory for the KV cache is reserved in full at startup.
Stores the chat history inside the model in compressed form. There is no Q6.
Keeps other chats in RAM so switching doesn\'t need a new prefill. 0 = off, 8192 = llama.cpp default (too much with 16 GB).
Up to 170 MB per checkpoint with Gemma 4 12B. llama.cpp default: 32
Prompt tokens per GPU job (prefill only). Larger = faster prefill, but more stutter. No effect on decode speed.
The model computes on the GPU. Don\'t use all 8 cores, otherwise nothing is left for the UI.
mlock has no effect without root (limit 64 KB).
\"off\" only works with Jinja and only if the template has a thinking switch.

string-array.name: kv_labels
string-array.item: f16 - no quantization, twice the memory
q8_0 - practically lossless, half the memory (recommended)
q5_0 - smaller, loss possible in long chats
q4_0 - smallest, loss possible in long chats

string-array.name: ub_labels
string-array.item: 64 - stable, faster prefill, noticeable lag at full context
128 - stable, even faster prefill, more lag
512 - llama.cpp default; GPU crash on Adreno 840 + Gemma 4 + FA

string-array.name: load_labels
string-array.item: none - straight into the GPU buffers (recommended)

string-array.name: template_labels
string-array.item: Jinja - template from the model (default, required for Gemma 4, tool calls, thinking)
--no-jinja - llama.cpp\'s built-in templates (doesn\'t work with Gemma 4)

string-array.name: reasoning_labels
string-array.item: auto - default, thinking on if the template supports it
off (--reasoning off) - if the web UI doesn\'t switch it off
